## Beta — Multi-day slots are now fully drawn

Fix for the weekly card: a slot spanning more than two days (e.g. Monday 09:00 → Thursday 09:00) used to draw only the first and last day, leaving the days in between empty. Every day the slot covers is now drawn — the start day up to the bottom of the grid, intermediate days at full height, and the end day from the top of the grid to the end time.

No changes to the scheduler or the services: only the card's rendering.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.4.0-beta1...v1.4.0-beta2
